scope: Owned ASS line/EOF lifecycle and checked style parser sessions; full library goal remains active.

operations.operation: Raw line ownership, trim and key/remainder split
operations.behavior: Rust owns UTF-16 key/remainder. FastTrimRight scans explicit length past NUL; TrimLeft stops at NUL. Predicate flags use CStringW::StrTraits::IsSpace. Colon search stops at NUL and absent separator leaves the full remainder intact. No Unicode scalar strings introduced.

ReadString false plus raw empty stops before trimming. A final comment/trimmed blank requests another read. A final processed record stops. Pending fields prevent next line; malformed numeric headers retain modeled reset and failure. ReadString always empties/replaces its output in both reference and candidate; no previous native buffer is an input dependency.

Style cursor, raw remainder, builder, field acceptance and result are owned by the validated document-bound ASS run. Supplied type must match current field. Final name/value snapshots are independent and native copies complete before the session is released and native AddStyle consumes its temporary STSStyle.

boundary_review.contract: Check output, EOF, raw UTF-16 byte length and predicate count before state mutation. Copy caller buffers before registry admission. Predicates must be strict bools. Input/output may overlap. Invalid phase/type/stale run or owner is rejected. Snapshots are copied out after loans end and survive run/document release.

Typed integer run ID binds a live document. Copy both raw text and remainder before admission. Exact integer/f64 bit results are supplied by native conversion after all Rust loans end. Validate command/type/shape/capacity. Independently owned snapshots reuse the existing style wire; no native object address or writable view is stored in Rust.

retirement_evidence: No declarations/implementations of the four value-building exports remain; final experimental native parser compile include traces on x86/x64 do not include xy_rust_ass_style.h. Legacy raw helpers remain for the native-document fallback, which is not the final target.
retained_boundaries: CTextFile read/file/encoding adapters and font installation remain native.

Default native-document fallback and public host implementations remain transitional C++.
